meta.title: ARCA — Your legacy, secured for the future.
meta.description: A highly secure digital time capsule and dead-man switch for your most important messages, documents, and memories.

hero.subheadline: A highly secure digital time capsule and dead-man switch for your most important messages, documents, and memories — delivered precisely when they matter most.

steps.title: Compose your message
steps.body: Write, record, or upload anything — text, voice, video, photos, documents. Use the rich editor or record directly in your browser.

steps.title: Set your trigger
steps.body: Choose a specific delivery date, or activate the dead-man switch. ARCA monitors your presence and acts only when it should.

steps.title: Guardians are consulted
steps.body: Before anything is sent, your trusted contacts confirm your status. One click from them keeps everything sealed for another 30 days.

steps.title: Delivered at the right moment
steps.body: Recipients receive a private, secure link — nothing before, nothing after. Your words arrive exactly as intended.

items.title: Military-Grade Security
items.body: Zero-Knowledge Encryption means your content is encrypted before it ever leaves your device. Not even we can read it. Your secrets stay yours.

items.title: Trusted Guardians
items.body: Before your Arca is ever delivered, up to 3 trusted contacts are consulted first. A single false positive is unacceptable — so we built a failsafe.

items.title: Rich Media & Drip Delivery
items.body: Record voice messages and videos. Attach files. Schedule parts of your message to unlock at different times — a letter today, a video on their birthday.

security.label: Security
security.body: Zero-Knowledge Encryption means your content is encrypted client-side before it ever reaches our servers. We store only ciphertext. Even in the event of a breach, your legacy remains private.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing.
pricing.subtitle: Start free, no credit card required. Upgrade when you're ready for unlimited everything.
